_comment: Algorithm tuning parameters. Changing these alters the pacing/sensitivity of the pedagogy. Values are ported from the SocraticCode (OpenCode) fork; see socratiskill.txt for rationale.
_calibration_comment: Up-leveling thresholds scale with current level: a novice needs more sustained evidence than an advanced user. Down-leveling stays flat (3/5) because being stuck above your level is worse than being stuck below it.
_scaffold_comment: Immersive scaffold window: how many NEW files the agent may create when the user explicitly grants one. The level scales the SIZE of the window, never the category of what is allowed — for a novice, typing boilerplate still builds fluency; for an advanced user it does not. max_lines is flat because tedium does not scale with level: an HTML skeleton is the same 80 lines for everyone. These are the knob to tune after real use.
